title: Integration Authentication Expiry Watch
dataSources: Home Assistant state/logbook events (`homeassistant:event`), Homey flow/insights (`homey:flow`), SmartThings events (`smartthings:event`), Hubitat/openHAB logs, Node-RED flow events (`nodered:event`).
app: Home Assistant / Homey / SmartThings / Hubitat / openHAB event streams via MQTT, webhooks, and REST - forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=homeassistant:event event_type=service_error
| where error_code="auth"
| stats count as auth_failures by integration
| where auth_failures>3
| sort - auth_failures
description: Watches for repeated authentication failures from cloud integrations whose tokens expired, accounts changed, or rate limits turned into hard lockouts.
value: Many smart-home outages are really API credential problems; this query turns a vague 'it stopped working' complaint into a fixable integration list.
implementation: Forward structured service errors from Home Assistant or Homey; alert when auth failures exceed your normal background noise.
visualization: Table of integrations by authentication failure count.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks which cloud-connected gadgets stopped talking to your smart home because the login or token went bad.
